terms.meaning: the inner area that actually moves when the user scrolls

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Scroll box and scroll bar
sections.what: Makes the scroll box, its inner viewport, and the thin bar that shows the scroll position.
sections.why: Likely reason: a custom bar keeps the same look on every browser.
sections.watch_out: Only a vertical bar is included in the root by default, so horizontal scrolling needs an extra bar from the parent.

summary: Wraps content in a box that scrolls, with a slim styled scroll bar.
purpose: Keeps long lists or text inside a fixed space with a tidy scroll bar.
why: Likely reason: browser default scroll bars do not match the app's look.
how: The root hides overflow. A viewport inside it holds the children and does the scrolling. A vertical scroll bar is included by default, and a corner piece fills the gap if both bars appear.
inputs: Children and style overrides, plus an orientation for the scroll bar.
outputs: A scrollable box with a styled bar.
risks: Scrolling needs a height limit on the root. Without one the box grows and never scrolls.
debug: If no scroll bar appears, check the root has a height or maximum height.
